policy: One new indexable URL requires one existing indexable URL to retire. This file authorizes no redirect, no noindex, no sitemap change and no deploy.

planned_additions.publication_gate: All release blockers in the source manifest must close first.

planned_retirements.reason: The prepared state-family audit identifies the family as near-duplicate and this URL had no measured demand in the recorded window.
planned_retirements.required_action_at_publication: Redirect to the honest banking hub only after that hub's unsourced claims are removed; remove the retired URL from discovery emitters in the same commit.

collision_note: The selected retirement is outside the existing 50-URL owner-gated state-family canary, so it is not double-counted against that batch.
release_note: Re-check trailing search data immediately before publication. If the retirement URL has since earned a click, replace it with another verified zero-demand URL and update this evidence file.
